components.description: Overview strip under long time series: drag the window to pan, drag a handle to zoom the main chart. Height 56; handles 6×24 with a 44 px hit area (target/min). Keyboard: ←/→ move, Shift+←/→ resize. React: <ChartBrush startIndex endIndex onChange />

Design System
Chart/Range brush
Overview strip under long time series: drag the window to pan, drag a handle to zoom the main chart. 1 variant.
Overview
What it is and when to reach for it.
When to use
Series longer than one screen (daily data over a year, live logs).
Users need to compare a period with the whole history.
Not on Mobile below 6 months of data — a period Segmented control is enough.

Mobile · 390

Dark mode
Every token flips; contrast stays above 3:1 for marks and 4.5:1 for text.
Default
Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
Height 56; sits 16 below the X axis of the main chart.
Handles keep a 44 px touch target even though they are drawn 6 px wide.
Snap the window to whole periods (day, week) for financial data.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.

Interaction
Drag window to pan; drag handles to resize; double-click resets.
Accessibility
Two sliders with aria-valuetext (“From 1 Jul”, “To 31 Aug”).
